overview.summary: Deliver Agent Workspaces and the retained Chat & Session Experience in one consolidated 0.27 bundle. Workspace execution and the reliable conversation loop begin independently; later stories consume their explicit contracts. Authoring stays private and execution/export waits for completed, published 0.26.1 plus baseline reconciliation. The bundle has two workspace stories, six conversation stories, and one combined documentation and qualification story.

sharedDecisions.title: Pinned execution principal is separate from project context
sharedDecisions.description: S01 owns persisted workspace/agent ownership and resolves operator-configured workspace binding once through existing session/execution seams. The owner principal remains owner; named workspace storage scope is exactly agent:<agent-id>, derived from the configured stable agent id, never a path/project/sender or tool argument. S05 owns selectable project/directory/reference context and next-turn provider/model settings; these cannot change workspace principal or bypass existing path/placement/tool authorization. S02 applies the same principal to canonical files, lexical/vector operations, tools and maintenance. Preserve baseline filesystem session ownership; no whole-session SQL migration. PRD FR1–FR3 own the exact product rules.

sharedDecisions.title: One submission and attempt authority with recoverable live state
sharedDecisions.description: S03 owns the stable submission/revision claim, message/attempt identity, durable ordinary queue and serialized admission/stop/dispatch transitions in existing session mutation/turn seams. Accepted attachments transfer before draft clearing. Live delivery is an invalidation/update projection reconciled against authoritative session/attempt state, including passive viewers and restart; a second durable event-log subsystem is not required. Consumers use the same identities. S04 extends durable displayable tool/request/result history and completed-message windows; it owns approval resolution and branch linkage. S06 attention/read markers project those requests/results without a second state machine. S08 supplies the explicit temporary lifetime exception.

sharedDecisions.title: Capabilities and retention describe tested execution
sharedDecisions.description: S05 supplies effective per-session provider/context availability through the existing harness capability boundary. S03 exposes steer as disclosed confirmed-stop-then-follow-up unless native injection is proven. S07 uses one authorized catalog and native skill invocation spelling; transport passthrough is distinct from native command support. S08 must trace all durable surfaces and disable unsupported retention combinations. S09 records actual provider/device outcomes and external release holds without manufacturing evidence. All UI owners consume existing Afterglow canon and update only their relevant integrated states.

stories.name: Documentation and integrated qualification
stories.scope: Operators and contributors have accurate public and private documentation, reconciled integrated designs, and a reproducible qualification record for both workstreams. Explicit public guide/architecture/glossary/changelog and private UX/spec/comparison tasks share this story. Own complete Q1–Q10/W1–W6 accounting and integrated automatic checks; retain external owner/device release gates as explicit unverified holds until real evidence exists.
stories.sequencing: Consumes every feature producer through the dependency graph. Per-feature tests and visual checks remain in their owners; final qualification never substitutes a child report, fabricated device evidence or a human-waiting unattended task for proof. Requires both canonical repositories in the maintainer execution context: commands run from public, private documentation changes target the verified private root. A public-only runner must resume this same story with that access; editing exported copies is insufficient and no automatic sync-back is introduced.
